text: Four stars for being cute asf However minuse one star for lasting a week on my keychain. Too sum it up, this is more decorative than functional.
Great deal for the money. Flow meter works perfect, thermometer reads fast.
These saved my fingers for sure. Very easy to use and was able to load quickly. Came in very handy when I loaded my four new magazines which were tight.
One of my favorite trilogies ever! Great characters and an amazing story! You'll love Mia and Adam as they work through their struggles and triumphs! Awesome books!

Bought this thinking I was getting a quality renewed device. Wrong. The screen has a weird yellow tint that's super noticeable when you compare it side by side with a friend's iPad. I tried adjusting the True Tone and night shift settings but nothing fixes it. The battery life is also terrible, dies after maybe three hours of just browsing Safari and watching YouTube. My old iPad Air 2 held a charge way better than this thing. The speaker crackles whenever the volume goes above fifty percent too. Definitely not worth the savings, just spend the extra money on a brand new one.

I figured this would be a dry, dated memoir but it's genuinely hilarious. Herriot's stories about eccentric farmers and impossible animals had me laughing out loud way more than expected. The Yorkshire countryside practically jumps off the page. Some chapters hit you right in the feels too. Way better than I anticipated for something written decades ago. Bought it on a whim and now I'm ordering the rest of the series immediately.
Absolutely worth every penny. Evie's journey had me tearing up by the end. Beautifully written and such a touching story.
Great little Trimmers! They're perfect for smaller sized birds! They're sharp & don't split their nails. They're just the right size for my tiels. We got them really fast & are very happy with them!
Perfect fit on my bike, solid feel, looks awesome. Super happy with it.
This is a great concept, however the holes do not fit 7-strand paracord. It is frustrating when it arrives and you realize that you have to drill out the holes to fit.
Too darn tight! This is not made for adults; they are made for children! Unless you weight 90 lb with no meat on your bones, these will not fit.

Even after thinking on it a while after I finished reading, I still have mixed feelings about this book. The characters were likable, especially Cade, but there were parts of the story that just didn't work for me. The main thing was some of the dialogue between Cade and Brook. I hate to say it, but it was juvenile at times, and very repetitive. As I said, I liked Cade. I really felt bad for him, and the way he seemed to be led on my Brook, and just waiting around for her to make a decision that would effect their possible future together. I did start liking the book more at the end, and was rooting for Cade and Brook to finally get their HEA. The book was long, and not being completely invested in the story until close to the end, it took me longer than usual to read, so to get to the end and see that there would be another book? I was pretty disappointed. I still can't decide if I liked the story enough to want to see what happens next.
Thought our picky eater would hate another wet food but she literally licks the bowl spotless every single time. Way better quality than I expected for the price.
Works perfectly on my CX-5, front camera feed is super clear at night. Plug and play install took maybe ten minutes.
Got this for early morning rides and the windproof front panel is a game changer. Fit is spot on and the fleece lining makes it super cozy without feeling bulky. Totally worth it.
A simple cable. Just what I was looking for. Works just fine.
Got this for my niece's birthday and she plays with it constantly. Perfect gift for any kid who loves hands-on toys.
No more getting dragged down the street. Works great and costs way less than other brands.

I love the light and the fact that it can easliy be removed. I also really like the idea of the mount. Unfortunatley the mount doesn't works so well. It fits great but the lever that keeps it tight will not stay closed. This means it won't stay tight. Fixed it with a rubber band. I'm going to keep it because I think the light is really well made.

The first Bissell Pet Hair Remover purchase was for my mother's home. There were 3 dogs (2 Great Danes and a 40 lb mutt), and 4 cats. There is carpeting throughout most of the house, and on all 27 (sigh) stairs. This thing got the stairs cleaner than I thought possible. We've brought them back to looking brand new - not to mention the work it did on the furniture. So, when I moved into a house with all hardwood floors but carpeted stairs (wait..what?), and two dogs...I knew what I had to do! I have a Great Dane, and a Terrier style mutt. Lots of blonde and white hair is attracted to those stairs. This thing made them brand spanking new in minutes. The suction is great - I am continually shocked that it is so powerful. The front end tool is fantastic. I can't say enough about this thing. I highly recommend it!!

Replaced my old unit that kept jamming every other week, and what a difference. This thing powers through everything I throw at it, potato peels, eggshells, even the occasional chicken bone. Installation took me about an hour start to finish, and the mounting system was way easier than the one on my previous Badger model. It's surprisingly quiet too compared to what I was used to. My wife noticed the difference immediately and asked if I actually finished the job or just left it off. I'd absolutely recommend this to anyone doing a kitchen upgrade or replacing a builder-grade disposal that's on its last legs. If you've got a big family and cook at home constantly, this is worth every penny. Six months in and zero issues.

This is a VERY LARGE umbrella. The colors are bright and because of the way it is vented the wind does not easily get up under it. The button to open it works easily and it closes as expected. It would be too expensive for my budget but is clearly and excellent umbrella.

Amazing product. Arrived on time and in good condition. This product is exactly as advertised. If you are looking for something like this then rest assured it is as it says it is. Very happy with purchase. BUT the rear sight amour's tool used to take it off won't fit on any ghost sight. You have to hammer it on by hand. It only took a clamp on a wood work bench, a flat head punch set and a hamer.

The straw is almost impossible to suck any water through, but I guess if you're going to be using it for drinking lake or river water it needs to be a good filter. I use the bottle without the straw and it works just fine as a bottle.
GREAT, EXACTLY WHAT I WANTED FOR MY FRONT CAMERA FOR MY NEW CX-9, OPERATES AS I WANTED, GREAT.
Great for the price and is a very good gripping off road tire.

Ordered this for my 10 month old niece's birthday and it arrived a day earlier than expected. Box was in perfect shape, no dents or crushed corners, which was a relief. The toy itself was easy to get out of the packaging and didn't require scissors or fighting with those annoying wire ties. Slapped some batteries in and she went straight for it. The lights are super bright and catchy, and the music isn't nearly as annoying as most baby toys which is a huge plus for her parents. She loves grabbing the gears off and chewing on them more than actually spinning them honestly. Everything feels solid and well made, no sharp edges or cheap plastic feel. Overall really impressed with the quality for the price. Would definitely recommend.
Great for fans of dark drama. My brother loved it too.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but these blew me away. I swapped out some old CFLs in my garage and the difference is night and day. They throw a super clean white light that actually makes the space feel bigger. Figured they'd be dimmer than the 100 watt incandescents I was used to, but they're every bit as bright if not brighter. No warm-up delay either, which is a huge plus. Been running two months straight with zero issues. Definitely stocking up on more.
So far my husband likes it and haven't had any issues even with the heart monitor.

Got this on Blu-ray for like six bucks and honestly that's a steal for how rewatchable it is. The whole casino heist thing never gets old for me. Soderbergh just knows how to make a movie look cool without trying too hard, and the cast is ridiculous in the best way. Pitt eating in every single scene is honestly a highlight. My only gripe is that Julia Roberts feels a little underused compared to everyone else, and the pacing drags slightly in the middle setup portion. But the payoff is worth it and the soundtrack is genuinely great. For what I paid, this is one of the best bargain pickups in my collection. Pop it in during a lazy weekend and you won't regret it.

Got this for my older tabby who kept clawing at the screen door every morning. Installation took maybe twenty minutes and the seal is tight enough that bugs aren't an issue. The flap moves easily for her but stays put in wind. I'd recommend this to anyone renting since you don't have to cut into the actual door. My neighbor is already ordering one.
Well written and inspiring. I love how so many characters turned to God. But not preachy Highly recommend this story.

Evans has done an outstanding study of the Third Reich. His previous two books on the subject are the most comprehensive to date in English! Evans gives us lots of informative, fascinating, insights into why what happened, happened! A very readable book, personally I like a more challenging vocabulary and sentence structure? This book includes more than a Third Reich buff could know about the progress of the war and about Hitler's subjegation of various populations. Evans gives us a better explanation into why Hitler did what he did along with the wars progress. I wish I had the time to read them all over! I thank Evan's for the work he has done. Thank you. I think this book is the best of the three!

Used this for about three weekends now with my Gamo at 700 FPS from 20 yards. The spinning action works fine and it's satisfying hearing the paddles clank around. That said, a couple of the plates are already warping and developing decent craters where they're getting hit repeatedly. Still functions okay but I question how many more sessions before something cracks. Fun while it lasts, just don't expect long-term durability.

I bought this because I do photo editing on a large monitor connected to my desktop, and sometimes I need to step back to check how things look from a distance. Running back and forth to make tiny adjustments was getting ridiculous. This thing completely solved that problem. I can stand across the room, look at the screen, and make adjustments on the fly. Setup was basically plug and play, and the tracking is surprisingly smooth even from 12 feet away. I'd definitely recommend this to anyone who does any kind of presentation work, or even just watches movies from their PC and wants to pause without getting up. Honestly, if you have any reason to control your computer from more than arm's length, just get it. Totally worth it.
Essential to any tool box for all the unexpected home repairs that come up- grip, lock, then loosen or tighten whatever needs adjusting without straining your hands

I had mild expectations for this product, after all it was just a toilet set right? I was pleasantly surprised as they way the seat attaches to the bowl is unique and allows for easy removal for cleaning. I like that! The only issue is that the seat is so glossy it shows every fingerprint and water spot. Maybe it will degloss some overtime.

I hate buying tool accessories but this thing is great. It works as well as I do and saves time. I love the easy rise system but I had to make some metal mounts so it would work with my Hitachi first gen 8&1/2 inch sliding compound saw. I really didn't like setting up my saw for precision cuts before. It always took too long, too much stuff, and too much time. Now I just roll it into the truck and away I go and the supports slide out far enough to actually help. I would have preferred it be a little narrower, and as others have said, solid tires instead of inflatable. Its really heavy but it's easy to move around and saves me time every time I use the saw. Would buy another if this one broke.

I wasn't sure what to expect for the price, but these outlet remotes have been a pleasant surprise. I needed a way to control lamps across my living room without walking behind furniture, and this does the job. The range is decent, it works from about 25 feet away and through one wall, though it occasionally takes a second button press. The plug-in modules are bulkier than I anticipated, so they partially block the second outlet on my wall plates. That's been my main annoyance. The remote feels lightweight and a little flimsy, but it's held up fine after a month of daily use. For basic home automation without spending a fortune, this delivers more than I expected. Just plan around the outlet space issue.

Used this to break loose some seriously rusted exhaust manifold bolts on my Silververado that had been on there for over 15 years. The extra leverage it provides is no joke, and it saved my knuckles more than once during this project. It is a bit bulky, so getting into tight spots takes some creativity, and you definitely want to pair it with beefy wrenches since it puts serious torque on whatever you are using. I would absolutely recommend this to any backyard mechanic or DIYer who regularly deals with stubborn, seized-up fasteners. Worth every penny.

Wanted to see how closely the movie stayed w/the book: extremely well, considering how movies often don't meet the book's detail or message. The book I hadn't read, so now I know both movie and book are great.

The quick-release mechanism is what sold me on this seat. Pop it right off, wipe under the hinges, snap it back on. No more gross buildup in those impossible crevices. My only complaint is the finish feels a bit cheap and plasticky compared to my old one. Not a huge deal for the price, but I expected slightly better quality. Still, the convenience factor alone makes it worth keeping.

Finally, a show about idiots, and 3 women in the lead roles! Jessica Knappett is a freaking GENIUS!!! Bill & Ted, Silicone Valley, That 70's Show, Curb Your Enthusiasm, Seinfeld, The Wayans Brothers, Martin, Bernie Mac--if anything in the list appeals to you at all, you will love this show! It may be a little uncomfortable for some at first, because we are conditioned to accept and expect women in such roles to be lampooned, for it to be no more than a cheap, misogynistic burlesque. This hilarious show is no joke. Well, not at women's expense, anyway. Don't let anyone convince you that simply because a show was created, written, and directed by a woman that it was not at women's expense--including hers. "Feminist" porn comes to mind. (I say this as a psychologist.) You have GOT to see this wonderful hot mess!!! Like the goddesses in Absolutely Fabulous, these losers remind me of myself and my friends.

Got the Kindle download instantly with no issues, which was great because I'd been waiting for Nick's story. The file loaded clean on my Paperwhite with zero formatting glitches. Right from the first chapter I was pulled in. Nick's always been the band member I wanted to know more about, and getting inside his head didn't disappoint. The family stuff with his sister and dad adds real weight to his character instead of just being the angry guitarist trope. I knocked off one star because the middle dragged a bit and some of the backstory felt repetitive if you've read the earlier books. But the chemistry between him and Lila is solid and the emotional moments actually landed for me. Overall a strong addition to the series.
Got this for my daughter's cubes and what a difference! Everything turns so smooth now. Even I've been playing with them nonstop. Totally worth it.
Had this cranking almost every day for eight months now. Still hits hard and clean, zero issues. Built like a tank and the bass never disappoints.
accurate description, works great, came on time, i'm very happy!

Bought this a few months back and honestly it's become my go-to everyday carry. The blade shape threw me off at first but after actually using it for a while I totally get the design. Cuts through boxes, rope, and packaging like nothing else. Fits perfectly in my jeans pocket without bulging out or weighing me down. Build quality is way better than what I paid for it honestly. The lockup is solid with zero wiggle and deployment is smooth right out of the box. Gets attention every time someone sees it but not in a sketchy way. Just looks like a well thought out tool. Couldn't be happier with this purchase and would buy again without thinking twice.

I've been suffering from negative thinking for a while now and this book helped switch my mind set up very quickly! The 10 steps outlined within this book relating to positive thinking has been life-changing for me. This is a great self help book for anyone looking to improve their life.
Arrived two days early in secure packaging. Pulled it out and the build quality immediately impressed me, solid and comfortable in hand. Still adjusting to the angle but so far really liking it.
I used them to stuff his treats toy and he would sit there for a while trying to get them out. He loved them.

Box arrived in rough shape, one corner was crushed and the tray had popped through the plastic packaging. Nothing was broken thankfully, but I was nervous opening it. The tray itself feels pretty solid though, heavier than I expected. Washed it out and filled it up with Fresh Step crystals for my 12-pound tabby. Initial impression is good, the rake mechanism moves smoothly and the cover sits snug. Only been four days so far so I can't speak to longevity yet, but no weird plastic smells and it assembled in about two minutes. Knocked off a star because the shipping situation was honestly a mess and the box looked like it got dropped down a flight of stairs. Product seems decent though.

I genuinely don't understand how this even got greenlit. The pacing is completely broken, nothing happens for the first hour except boring dialogue in a living room. When the horror stuff finally kicks in, the practical effects look like they bought everything from a Halloween clearance aisle. The creature design is the real letdown though. You barely see it, and when you do it's just a rubber suit that wouldn't scare a toddler. Lighting is so dark in the third act you literally can't tell what's happening on screen. I watched this with three friends and we kept checking how much time was left. Skip this one entirely and save your evening for something that actually delivers on its trailer.

Decent pirate card game for the price. My group plays it occasionally but it's not our first choice. The mechanics are straightforward enough once you get going. Cards feel a bit thin and the artwork could be brighter. You get what you pay for really. Fun but not amazing.
Quick read. Worth the download, but glad it was free. Really nothing special here, but nothing particularly wrong with it, either.
Creative to the point of absurdity; I gave it to my brother-in-law who loves maps. He loved it.

Bought this for a work conference dinner and it was perfect. The fabric has enough give to sit comfortably without wrinkling, and the cut is super forgiving around the midsection. I'm 5'6" and about 160 lbs, the medium hit right at the knee, which I thought was flattering without being too short for a professional setting. I'd highly recommend this to anyone who needs something polished for events where you want to look put-together but still be comfortable all evening. Washed mine on gentle and hung it to dry, no issues.
Wow the Walker brothers are just amazing. Can't wait for the story on Braydon's twin. I love Nicole Edwards books!!!

Bought this as a gag birthday present for my brother-in-law and it was the hit of the party. The quality is honestly better than I expected for the price. Similar novelty items cost way more and aren't nearly as well made. It's sturdy enough to actually use but honestly he's keeping it on his desk as a conversation piece. Absolutely worth every penny if you need a funny, affordable gift.
Arrived quick in a sturdy box, no damage. Fits my Glock 19 perfectly and seems well-built for the price. Happy with it so far.

Sloppy fit between the jug and the electric motor, necessating having to hold on to the whole thing with both hands when I turned it on. Poor seal between the Jar and the cap caused a spillage mess. No variable rheostat so I couldn't start slowly and avoid a jump of the liquid in the jar. I believe the next time I go to the rifle range I'll take this thing with me so I can have the satisfaction of killing it.

Bought 2 copies, one for dad & one for me. Dad also has an autographed ORIGINAL copy from the original printing 20 years ago. I shared my copy with 2 guys at work, one whose dad fought on Iwo Jima too - they both loved the book too.

I've had this on my Kindle for about three months now, reading it on and off during commutes. The download holds up fine across devices, synced between my Paperwhite and phone app without any glitching or formatting issues, which is more than I can say for some indie titles. The story itself is decent. Darker hero with a vendetta, federal agent love interest, fairly standard plot but entertaining enough. My main gripe is the pacing drags hard around the sixty percent mark. Same confrontation rehashed three different ways before anything actually moves forward. The romance felt rushed compared to the action stuff. Not bad for the price, kept me occupied on a few flights, just not something I'd revisit. Three stars feels right, solid but forgettable.
I'm a fan of blowfish anyway BUT these are my favorite boots ever. True to size. Comfortable. And great for anyone with bigger calfs.

I have mixed emotions about this water filter system. I love how it is hung from a tree, and doesn't require pumping, but I did run into problems. I used it for a week in Boundary Waters, at least the bag. After 4 days,providing water for 6 people, the filter was completely clogged, and is incapable of being back flushed. The pre-filter screen was not fine enough to catch the "material/ suspected tannin" in the BWCA water. I eventually attached a Sawyer inline filter to the outlet hose which got me through the last 4 days. My Base Camp Pro did come with the new and improved filer, but it couldn't handle what I needed it to. I love the idea, but was pretty disappointed.

This was such a sweet friends-to-lovers story. I really appreciated how the author wove in the mother's matchmaking scheme, it added a fun layer of tension without feeling forced. The callbacks to characters from earlier books were a nice touch too. Definitely worth reading.
Arrived quickly with zero leaks. The bottle was sealed properly and the dropper is easy to use. Cats didn't mind it at all.
My cats love these hammocks there so strong I would definitely buy again and recommend to any friends or family

I have went through the mess of choosing new heaters and most really are not very good. This one is very good. It is simple, it takes up small space, and temperature has worked spot-on for the first couple of months. It lays sideways, so you can put it low in the back of aquarium and not see it if you want. It has a nice temperature gage and different lights come on when it is in session. It is not digital, but really who cares? You should always have another thermometer in there to check. Have the one on your heater, and then one of the $1.50 ones you can get at any petshop. Who says your fancy digital one is correct you scummy digital heater buyers!

Bought this before a weekend hiking trip and ended up finishing it in two sittings. The author's descriptions of solo backcountry travel are spot-on, she captures that mix of freedom and vulnerability perfectly. I'd especially recommend this to women who spend time outdoors alone, but honestly anyone who enjoys wilderness memoirs will get sucked in. The emotional honesty caught me off guard in the best way. Already passed my copy to a friend who through-hikes the AT.

Cute idea but honestly pretty flimsy. My adult cat sent the whole thing sliding across the floor on the first swat. The suction cup base barely holds on to anything and the dangling part came undone after maybe ten minutes of play. That said, my friend's tiny kitten loved it and was gentle enough that it stayed intact. If you have a young, lightweight cat who isn't aggressive with toys yet, this could be fine. For any cat with real power behind their paws, skip it.

I have an impersonal and ever-so-slight connection to the Johnson family (unbeknownst to them) and I was eager to read a 'family history'. This book is not really that. Although it does impart so knowledge and insight, I doubt this book is a sanctioned review of the Johnson heirs. This is the 2nd or 3rd book I've read about America's wealthy elite and sadly, they all sound tragically alike. People without jobs and direction flounder to find purpose in their lives. Few find it in the solace of religion or any other worthy, yet non-lucrative means. This book saddened me, although, being part of the working class population, I did find it somewhat fascintation to see 'how the other 1% lives'.

Thought these would be great for my kids' craft projects but the impressions are practically invisible. Super disappointing given how cute the designs look in the listing photos. My daughter gave up trying after ten minutes.
Got this for my sister who never reads thrillers and she finished it in two days. Would hands down recommend to anyone wanting a gripping weekend read with believable characters and real tension.

Picked up this 20-piece set wanting something budget-friendly for everyday meals. Honestly, it falls right in the middle for me. The pattern looks nice enough from a distance but up close the finish seems a little flat compared to what I saw online. They're lighter than I expected which makes them feel kind of cheap in hand. My older set from a different brand had way more weight and held up better against water spots. These haven't rusted yet but I'm being careful about drying them right away. For the money they're acceptable if you just need something functional, but don't expect premium quality.
Honestly didn't expect much for the price but these are surprisingly sturdy. The shades are gorgeous and exactly as pictured. Really impressed.

I really loved the book Nights in Rodanthe, so I had mixed feelings reviewing this movie because I didn't like some of the changes they made. I loved Richard Gere and Diane Lane in the movie, which is why I gave it a four star rating. It is a sweet love story and the chemistry between Gere and Lane is really nice. This is a case where I do think the book was definitely better than the movie, but the movie is good.
Good price and very simple just like i wanted it for my pirate costume.

Picked this up for five bucks in the bargain bin and honestly that's about what it's worth. The concept grabs you right away and the first half builds some decent tension. Cameron Diaz and James Marsden do fine with what they're given. Problem is the movie completely unravels in the last forty minutes. What starts as a tight moral dilemma turns into this weird sci-fi mess that makes zero sense. Frank Langella is creepy without even trying though, I'll give it that. For the price I paid I can't complain too much. It's watchable on a lazy Sunday afternoon when you've got nothing better to do. Just don't expect the ending to actually explain anything. Three stars feels right. Cool premise, messy execution, but cheap enough to justify owning.

Hey folks, some of you have complained about not being able to get your hand into the disposal to pull things out. Guess what -- that's a very intentional design measure to protect you by keeping you from putting hands where they don't belong. If the beast can grind up beef bones, guess what it will do to your hand!!!! Maybe you think the disposal is safe when turned off, but so have people who considered a gun as safe when they didn't realize if was loaded. It would be nice if the design didn't have to deal with abuse, misuse and stupidity -- but unfortunately it does. Don't make yourself a victim. If you accidentally drop something into the disposal, use tongs of some sort to retrieve the item -- NOT your friggin' hand. Still, be VERY careful because the motor has enough power to throw the tongs at you VERY forcefully.

Picked this up on a whim and ended up devouring it over a long weekend. The protagonist is sharp and self-deprecating without crossing into pitiful territory, which is a tricky balance a lot of authors in this space get wrong. Her dating misadventures had me literally laughing out loud on the train more than once. The pacing does drag a bit around the middle section where the work drama takes over, and I found myself skimming a few chapters to get back to the relationship stuff. That said, the ending was satisfying and didn't feel rushed. I'd definitely recommend this to fans of Helen Fielding or Sophie Kinsella, especially women in their late twenties and thirties who've navigated the nightmare of urban dating. Perfect beach read material.
Works great and fits perfectly. Just what my shop vac needed.

You definitely need to read Killing Matt Cooper before jumping into this one or you'll be completely lost. That said, this sequel takes everything great about the first book and cranks it up. The thing I really want to highlight is the pacing. Cassian doesn't waste a single page. Every chapter pushes the story forward with zero filler, which is rare for a second book in a series. Usually authors slow down to set up the next installment, but not here. The psychological elements go way darker than I expected, and the main character's internal monologue gets genuinely unsettling at times. I finished it in two sittings because I literally couldn't put it down. If you liked the first book, just buy this one right now. You won't regret it.

Ring arrived in a tiny plastic baggie, no box or padding. The band was already bent and one of the smaller accent stones was loose in the bag. Put it on and the metal felt super cheap. Returned it the same day. Don't bother.
Got this for under ten bucks and honestly worth every penny. The arena scenes had me staying up way too late. Such a gripping plot with real emotional depth. Couldn't put it down.

This is a very handy work light. You can use it as a flashlight, but I probably won't. I have much brighter flashlights. However, the three light wings on the sides are adjustable, and provide an excellent area light suitable for camping or working on my vehicle after dark. I think we will carry this in out RV. By the way, I spent ten minutes rapidly switching both switches in an attempt to duplicate the lock up problem others have reported, but it worked perfectly. I will amend this review if that changes. I took off one star because the magnet in the base needs to be stronger.

We have a very stubborn almost 2 year old lab/boxer mix that loves to pull on walks. This calmed her down instantly. She's no longer combatively pulling when we walk her and she does great! Took some getting used to for her, but this works like a charm.

Couldn't pass up this set given the price compared to similar pans. I've baked three loaves of banana bread so far, and every single one slid right out without any spray or parchment. The silicone feels substantial, not thin or cheap at all. Cleanup took about ten seconds. They nest together nicely in my cabinet too. Honestly, for what these cost, I expected to be replacing them within a month, but they're holding up beautifully. Grabbed a second set for my mom.

Ordered two of these to swap out the old toilets in our house and I'm honestly shocked at the difference. Shipping was fast and both arrived double-boxed with zero cracks or scratches, which was a relief. Installation took about an hour per bathroom with no weird surprises. The flush on this thing is no joke, moves everything down in one go. Comes with everything needed to get it mounted right away. Seat feels solid and the finish is easy to wipe clean. For the price point I really don't think you can do better. Already planning to buy a third one for our basement half bath next month.

This is very good product at an exceptional price. The thing that bothers me though is that it often seems to fry the foods at the ridges instead of grill. In turn, there is an appearance of grilling but a fried texture. This may be due to the width of the ridges and the non-stick coating. However, I think this is common to all makes of these pans. Face it, nothing beats a true grill. Nice to have this when it is raining or just too cold to fire up the BBQ.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but this little chair has been the surprise hit of our living room. My 10 month old son figured out how to sit on it within a day and now heads straight for it every morning. The songs are actually tolerable compared to most baby toys we own which is a huge plus. The interactive book part surprised me the most, he flips through it constantly and the veggie theme is cute without being annoying. It's sturdier than I anticipated too, he's pulled himself up on it multiple times and it hasn't tipped once. Way better quality than similar chairs I looked at from bigger brands. Only complaint is I might need a second one eventually because his older sister keeps stealing it.

I remember the first time I saw this movie in the theatre. Magical is the word for it. It had everything a great movie can have: comedy, suspense, adventure and a love story between a little boy and his friend from outer space. A wonderful movie for all times. I bought this dvd to relive that adventure and to have in my movie collection. Highly recommend this to everyone of every age. It's a masterpiece for sure.
Works well for my golden retriever most of the time. She occasionally tips it but keeps her from gulping water. Sturdy and simple to rinse out.
This is not the "bendable" soft bone like the other one this company sells. My dog goes nuts for the bendable one thats minty. This one, she won't touch.

I do not own this rifle but am open to purchasing one. The reviews are very positive, but some reviewers mention 'barrel-droop.' Amazon even sells a device to bolt onto the gun to mitigate 'barrel-droop' so this must be a real issue. Reviews of other manufacturers' guns do not mention 'barrel-droop' so I can only conclude that RWS has an issue other manufacturers do not. Picked this up for under ten bucks and honestly it's worth way more. The firsthand accounts of ordinary people surviving under the regime are gripping and hard to put down. Some sections drag a bit with political background, but the personal stories make up for it. I finished it in a weekend and kept thinking about it for days after. Arrived two days earlier than expected, which was a nice surprise. The box came in a larger Amazon box with those air pillow things, so no dents or crushed corners anywhere. Inside, the cooler was snug in its own molded foam and the mounting hardware came in a labeled little baggie, nothing rattling around loose. First impressions out of the box: the fins feel solid, not flimsy, and the pre-applied thermal paste looked even and clean. Heatsink has some decent weight to it. Honestly for what I paid I wasn't expecting it to feel this well-built. Knocking one star because the instructions are basically a single folded sheet with tiny diagrams that took me a minute to decipher. Otherwise really happy so far, just got it mounted tonight.
I loved it until one of the sides broke from pushing down on it. But I ordered another one. It is not heavy duty though so slice carefully.

The Fulcrum 30030-308 wireless remote LED light is a simple and effective way to add light to a room or a closet that doesn't already have a light and a light switch. It's a battery-operated setup and remarkably easy to install with double-backed tape. In fact, there is an on/off switch on the light itself so you don't even need to use the wireless remote to control the light if you're just adding the light to a small hallway closet or under a cabinet to light up a workbench. The built-in adjustable timer works great and automatically turns off the light after a pre-selected period of time (to save battery life) if you forget to turn off the light. My only minor complaint is about the size of this set. I'm glad the light is "tall" from top to bottom and "wide" from side to side so that the light source is large enough to be both bright and soft instead of looking like a flashlight... but the light fixture itself is pretty "thick" or "fat" from front to back and that makes it less than ideal if you're trying to hide this light under a cabinet or on the wall in a small closet. Similarly, the remote light switch is unusually large compared to how small other wireless on/off remotes are. Bottom line, this works and I'm mostly happy with it, but I'd be even happier if the light fixture was "flatter" from front to back and the remote light switch was smaller.

I like that the aluminum ones are lightweight and don't corrode, which matters for outdoor stuff. The bad: out of 500 I'd guess 30-40 had the stem stick instead of breaking off flush. For the price they're decent enough if you don't mind sorting out some duds along the way.

Acorn Media has provided the DVD with english subtitles which are helpful not only to people who have hearing impediments but to foreigners (specially when politician explain very quickly intricate schemes, with names of men we know nothing about). The story is very interesting from an historical point of view. It begins with Napoleon III being dismissed and ends some times after the Second World War is over. Politics are not seen from Sirius, but through magnifying glasses: dayly and often cynical calculations, fights against political ennemies or so-called friends. Randolph's every days life is a sort of thrilling gambling. For instance, he resigns his charge, thinking the government will become aware it can't do without him; in case it doesn't Randolph will found a new Tory group, modern, kenner on social issues, and overcome the old Tory party. We see how times are changing: at the beginning of the story, upper classes are extremely conservative, prjudiced with birth, wealth, morals, etc and at the end, one of Jennie's niece, an artist, goes to Russia on her own to see what communism is like. Lady Churchill is a fascinating woman! Clever, brave, ambitious, free, quite different from the other women of her time. With such "political beasts" as his father and mother were, we understand why Winston Churchill (remarkably played by Warren Clark) was so outstanding a stateman. Love stories don't lack in the movie; I found particularly moving the love affair between Jennie and the long-suffering Count Kinsky (embodied by the wonderful Jeremy Brett; if you like him, look at "posthumous Bafta for Jeremy Brett" on facebook).Though many tragic events occur (Randolph illness and demise, wars...), the dialogues, always brilliant, are often amusing: clever, cynical, sparkling with wit. People of the high society are depicted in a satirical way. Everything is beautiful: houses, costumes, music, actors: Lee Remick, Jeremy Brett...I find 361 minutes were hardly enough.

Of the three Tunable White BR30 bulbs I bought three months ago, one is already dead. (That's a really, really short life for an LED bulb!) Even before that, there were a couple of flaws that really bothered me: - Apparently, you can set the default color temperature if, and only if, you have the Sylvania hub. I don't have the Sylvania hub; I'm using SmartThings. With SmartThings, I'm stuck with 2700k lights (at initial power delivery); we wanted something closer to 6500k. I don't really want to purchase a new, dedicated hub for a one-time settings pressing. (This is absolutely a preference thing, but feel like there ought to be some other way to do this; you shouldn't have to buy a hub for a one-time use if they're going to tout compatibility with another hub!) - Pairing mode is too easily triggered. I have a toddler and on multiple occasions now, she's managed to put the bulbs back into pairing mode (which unpairs them from our hub). GE Link bulbs' pairing process was an absolute pain, but we never accidentally triggered pairing with a few off/on toggles like we have with the Sylvania bulbs. - The dimmest setting isn't as dim as Hue or LIFX bulbs (but seems to be on par with GE Link and Sengled). - SmartThings Routines that trigger changes to brightness and color temperature sometimes only do one or the other. Two of the three bulbs still work, but we're not really using them as smart, tunable bulbs because of the flaws listed above.

I decided to purchase a newer canister type filter. The reason for this is my 54 gallon tank had been shut down for 3 months with only the dried up gravel in it. So I started it back up in October of 2014 with my Magnum 350. I decided to test my tank for ph and ammonia levels and found out that the ammonia was 1.0 ppm too high. Of course I immediately dosed the tank with Ammo Lock. Other then that the tank was doing well with no fish in it as of yet. Because of the ammonia I went to my local pet store supplier and purchase the Aqua top CF400UV. Installed it and within 24 hours the tank started to cloud up. I made several water changes and cleaned the filter several times over a period of 2 weeks to no avail. I contacted my local supplier and they replaced it thinking it must have been defective. Well! The tank never cleared even after another 10 days of water changes and filter changes. So I thought I would reinstall my Magnum 350. Within 12 hours my tank was nearly clear. After 24 hours it was crystal clear. So I guess I have to say that I either got two defective filters or the Aqua top 400 UV just could not handle my water condition. I have over 30 years experience with fish and tanks and I am baffled by this. I found the filter easy to use and to be very quiet. Just as an FYI for others who are new to this non self priming filter. You should fill the canister first about 1 from the top and install the cover then fill the in and out inlets. Hook it up and just press the primmer button twice or more and just turn it on and you are good to go.

The Turning Point isn't as lightweight as it appears. Shirley MacLaine's performance as the dancer-turned-mother and wifie, and Ann Bancroft's role as the aging ballerina who won't let go of the past is quite realistic. Each woman is struggling with an ego that won't allow them to voice their true emotions, all fear-based and poignant. One fears that she wasn't ever good enough to become the star her friend went on to be, and hides behind motherhood and a veiled jealousy of her daughter who is definitely on her way. The other is also jealous of the life her friend has, and fears growing old and being forgotten by the dance world she loves and hates. As Shirley MacLaine's character seeks answers through infidelity and anger, Ann Bancroft takes Shirley's daughter hostage, pets and spoils her - all to feed her own self-confidence. Frankly, I think the cat fight on the roof is a wonderful scene, because finally, the two friends are able to show her fear and anger of being forgotten and growing old, and express their desire for something they can never have, for whatever reason, to each other. Watching Mikhail leap through the air is indeed a pleasure as well; but I personally enjoy his love scenes and Leslie Brown's long arms reaching to the sky as she falls in love with him. It's a wonderful movie. See it, buy it, love it for what it is.

This book will really help you to appreciate your childern and your life. Parenting is never easy, but when I read such a inspiring story like this, how I can not appreciate my fairly normal life. Walker is Ian Brown's son. Walker is one of about 300 other people worldwide who have a syndrome called cardiofacioutaneous (CFC). Ian talks about taking care of Walker, both the good and the bad. Ian writes about his marriage, other daughter, and his quest of understanding his life with Walker. Brown not only chronicles his honest journey (both good and the hard) of taking care of his disabled child, but is actually going on a quest to educate himself (and us) about the condition of CFC. Ian meets other families with CFC and becomes almost the experts himself on it. He learns/teaches us to love himself, Walker, and to believe in the life he has been given. You will love this book, and I hope it inspires you to believe in the life (lives) you have been given.

It's a touch small for my morning tea habit, but honestly I bought it more as a display piece for my shelf and it nails that purpose perfectly. Would happily order another in a different pattern.
Love how lightweight this bandana is. Doesn't feel suffocating during long shifts outside. Blocks dust well and washes clean without shrinking. Perfect for yard work.

Been using this harness daily for about six months now on my yorkie and it's held up amazingly. The clips still snap shut solidly, no fraying anywhere, and the fabric hasn't faded despite constant outdoor adventures. Still just as secure as day one. Solid little camera bag for day trips. I packed my DSLR with a attached lens, couple extra batteries, lens cloth, and a small charger. It's tight but workable if you pack smart. The padding feels decent and the strap is comfortable enough for all-day wear. Wish the front pocket was a bit roomier though. Overall pretty happy with it.

Bought this on a whim for family game night and it's been a total hit. What I really love is the peeling and flipping mechanic, everyone plays simultaneously so there's zero waiting around for your turn. My teenagers actually put their phones down, which says a lot. The banana-shaped pouch is a nice touch too, makes cleanup and travel super easy. We've taken it on vacation twice already. Only heads up: the tiles are smallish so keep them away from toddlers. Ordered this heater on a Tuesday and it showed up by Thursday, nicely packed in a sturdy box with plenty of padding so nothing was rattling around. First impressions were solid, it has a clean, compact design that felt well put together out of the wrapper. The digital readout on the front is a nice touch and way easier to read than the old screw-dial ones I'm used to. Set it up in my 20 gallon that evening and it got to temperature surprisingly fast, maybe 45 minutes or so. I like that you can tuck it horizontally near the bottom and it basically disappears behind the plants. Only been running about a week now but holding steady at 78 with zero fluctuations. If you believe in raising your child to be a "free spirit" who can be disrespectful and poorly mannered, then don't buy this book. However, if you are a parent who wants to raise a child you can be proud of, then this is a great read. It follows the authors personal experience with raising his three daughters. Unfortunately many parents today can't be bothered teaching and modeling values and positive personal characteristics to their children. Hence, the rise in children living on the edge, crime, disrespect and just plain old poor behavior. As an educator, it is refreshing to read about a dad who sets standards of behavior. The mattress showed up on the doorstep in a box approximately 5 feet tall, and weighing around 50 lbs. Possible to move alone, but way better with a helper. We opened one side of the box and slid the mattress onto our box spring. So surprised to find it vacuum sealed for maximum flatness! (Very helpful when putting it into position.) The mattress started growing to size as soon as the plastic was cut, so I recommend having a plan to discard the plastic and to make sure the top and head/foot of the mattress are in their proper positions. Out of curiosity, we laid on it within 10 minutes of "inflation" and were already pleased with the amount of "squish", comfort, and support. Upon returning from dinner, the bed was at it's advertised 10 inch mark and ready for another test. The "sink" was far more dramatic than the first go. Compared to other memory foam mattresses, the "sink" on this one is incredibly snug and articulate. Indentations were even made by the weight of my elbows. Lumbar support is excellent. Head and neck support is very comfortable. I could probably sleep on this thing without a pillow. It may be too squishy or soft for those who like a firmer bed, but time will tell and we may adjust. Also, fresh out of the box, it has an odd paint odor to it, so an open window and/or a fan is suggested. In regards to the "gel-infused cooling layer", I admit that I was skeptical. Though, on this very hot day, I surprisingly have yet to sweat while lying on the bed. Consider me impressed. ****First night's sleep: Great! Woke up about the same # of times, but went back to sleep quicker than usual. No back or hip pain this morning!
Finally my pots and pans are organized. Freed up a ton of shelf space. Super sturdy too.

"It's just a box." So you get a box and are offered a million dollars to push the button. But someone will die. Is that really any different than someone handing you a gun and offering you a million dollars for a hit? Why are they even sitting around saying, "should we push it?". With a gun there would be no question. But take away the name and face of the victim, and all of a sudden, "it's just a box." That was the one thing that really baffled me. Did they really think there would be no consequences to their actions? No, I take it back. That was not the only thing that baffled me. The entire second half of the movie baffled me. I will still give it 3 stars because it held my attention throughout, but once they introduced the extraterrestrial element, they lost me. I've watched the movie twice now and I just do not understand it. I was feeling pretty stupid until I read some other reviews and found that it didn't make sense to most people who saw it...even the people who loved it!

Paul G. Is great in this wonderful story about a man who was a true patriot of impeccable integrity.

The first two chapters were a bit slow-going, and I actually came back to the book about a month after I initially started it. However, once I got into it I couldn't put it down. The author constructs a wonderful world to set her story in and develops strong, interesting characters over the three books. In the first book, A Great and Terrible Beauty, she outlines her initial plot about a girl raised in colonial India but forced to move to a boarding school in late 19th century England after her mother is murdered. The intrigue, romance, fantastical elements, and believable scenery of England during that era make it an engaging tale. It is a great story, but also very well written. By the end of the book, I was carrying my Kindle everywhere and already anticipating buying the next installment in the series!

I bought this to mount Board Buddies on my Dewalt-744 table saw. The saw has a 19.5" fence, so I had to cut the aluminum slide on both ends with a hack saw so that the wood screw holes would be centered over an auxiliary wooden fence a.k.a feather board that I made. The saw's aluminum fence is 1" wide with screws on its back side away from the blade. I had to replace the Dewalt screws with equivalent 2" sheet metal screws to attach the featherboards. I made the wooden fence out of two pieces of 3/4" hickory so that it would be hammer-handle tough. I needed two pieces to make the fence wide enough to take wood screws from the slider as it is 2 1/4" wide. The holes for the wood screws in the slider are set 1 3/4" from the edge. Ideally, one would make the featherboard out of one piece that is 1 1/4" thick, but good luck trying to find some. All went well until I had to screw the aliminum slide onto the auxilary wooden fence. I drilled deep pilot holes. But, two of the brass-colored wood screws provided with the slide snapped off when the screws got deep into the wood. The first time it happened, I was able to recover by separating the two hickory boards and unscrew the stub because the screws fell exactly between the featherboards. Then I decided to glue the boards together so that the screws would be more secure. On my second attempt to mount the slider, a second wood screw snapped. This one was much more difficult to extract. I had to use a hand grinder to dig a pit around the stub so that I could get a lock wrench on it. MY ADVICE: use the stainless steel wood screws that are supplied with the Board Buddies instead of the cheap brass-colored screws that come with the slider.

Shut the fan off and clean it thorough if you smell the oder of burning hair or other burning smells.

Until LED's came along I was regularly changing light bulbs in my house, and they aren't cheap. These are more costly but you get the money back in longevity. At this point most of the lights in our home are LEDs, and almost all of them are by FEIT. In the last two years since I started switching over to these I've only had one go bad out of about 30-40 lamps. They produce less heat than incandescents. This saves you more money when you are cooling your house, less money when you were warming it anyway with a furnace. But either way, less heat generated. The light is whiter than incandescent. They dim down to a point then go out suddenly. They may buzz a little when dimmed, depending on the quality of dimmer you use. Some dimmers are not designed for LED or CFL bulbs. I called the FEIT hotline to find out how you can take advantage of the lifetime warranty. They said you don't need the packaging, just the bulb and the receipt.

So it was to that kind of place to which this book took me back, certainly as the character Cherie describes her desire to order up the perfect man, and then goes on a funny and insightful journey of eroticism, rejection, conflict, confusion and pulling it all together again.
