I absolutely love that Emma follows her heart even though if she feels wrong while doing it. Sometimes doing something seen as "wrong" can have an amazing ending and this book is just one of the ways it can happen. Lucia is an amazing writer and I can't wait to read more of her writing.

I'd strongly recommend these to anyone doing long runs or triathlon training with a GPS watch. I was ruining my Forerunner's charging port because salt crust would build up underneath after every workout. Slipped one of these on and the problem disappeared completely. The material pulls moisture away from your skin before it can creep into the sensor contacts. They wash easily too, just toss them in with your running gear and air dry. For around the cost of a coffee, you're protecting hardware that set you back hundreds. Honestly every runner I know who wears a watch should grab a couple of these. Total no-brainer purchase.
Great medium sized trash can. Takes Simple Human bags size E. Works well like all Simple Human products. Looks great.

Took this on a three-night trip in Colorado and overall it held up nicely. The hip belt pockets are my favorite part, fit my phone and snacks perfectly for easy access on the trail. Only complaint is the hydration sleeve is tight and tough to route a hose through. Solid buy for the price.
Bought this for my niece's birthday and she plays with it constantly. Tons of activities packed into one toy. Honestly worth way more than what I paid. Definitely recommend.

Honestly expected more based on the description. My two adult cats showed zero interest in this thing. I sprinkled a generous amount of their favorite catnip on the flower part and left it in their favorite lounging spot for days. Nothing. One of them briefly pawed at it once before walking away to nap elsewhere. The build quality seems fine and it hasn't fallen apart or anything, but it's just way too tiny for a full-grown cat to comfortably use. Maybe a young kitten would enjoy it, but for my guys it's basically just taking up floor space at this point. Been sitting untouched in the corner for about two weeks now. Wouldn't really recommend unless you have a very small kitten.
Honestly expected these to feel cheap and flimsy but they're surprisingly solid. My bristlenose loves pushing them around and the tank water has stayed noticeably clearer since adding them.
Fits perfect. No issues, no complaints. Good quality. Doesn't dissapoint.
Heavier duty metal than expected. The adhesive is a foam based and plenty adequate. Flex duct easily fits on this collar.

This system really does work and it's easy to set the times I needed hot water 4 times a day in the Master bathroom which was the furthest from the hot water heater. Installation was easy with the instructions provided. The worst thing was wasting water letting it run until it was hot. Now I no longer waste a lot of water. This unit is great for plumbing that does not have a dedicated hot water return line.
Expected way better quality for the price. Stopped powering on after barely three weeks of use.

They arrived tossed in a thin plastic mailer with zero protection, so the shoe box was completely crushed and one side was split open. Honestly looked like somebody stepped on it. The shoes themselves were shoved flat inside, totally creased across the toe. They feel stiffer than I expected right out of the box and the arch support is basically nonexistent, which is frustrating since that's the main reason I picked these. Color is slightly off too, more of a dull grey than the white shown online. Disappointing first impression overall, still deciding if I want to bother returning them.

I'm only giving 2 stars because of how annoying this toy gets. It's so loud and there is no on off or lower volume setting. As soon as the battery is in if the trigger is pulled it goes off extremely loudly. It's a good product maybe for a child old enough to play outside on there own but for my toddler the fact I could not turn it off or adjust the volume made this toy a hell on earth for me. However it does work well and lights up and blasts loudly for the price so if you don't mind the fact it's never ending, then go for it!!!!

Had this set up for about eight months now for my three year old and it's held up great. She jumps on this thing constantly and nothing has loosened up or wobbled. The finish still looks good too, no scratches or chipping even with daily abuse. Assembly was straightforward, took maybe twenty minutes. Honestly expected something flimsier for the price but this has been rock solid. Would definitely buy again.
Mounted this on my kayak bow last weekend. Super bright and wiring was simple. Perfect for anyone needing solid nighttime navigation lighting.

As a huge Superman fan I'm ashamed to say that I've never read the Death of Superman, but given that fact I thought this was was reasonably well done. At the end of the day the question is whether or not what you saw entertained you, and for me that answer was yes. However, I didn't pay to see it, so my expectations may be lower.
Got these for my neighbor's golden retriever and he goes nuts for them. Perfect gift for any squeaker-obsessed pup.
Thought these would fail after a week holding my heavy tablet on the fridge. Three months later, hasn't budged. Way stronger than expected.
Way too expensive for what you get. The cord channels are undersized and won't accept standard 550 cord without modifications. Cool idea but not worth the money or hassle.

The battery lasts a long time and they look very nice, but the sound just is not as good as I wanted. They charge up fast, they are comfortable, but my $30 corded studio headphones sound better. I really wish these sounded better, but they are just a little too flat. They are good workout headphones however The build quality is very nice they look attractive and seem solid to the touch, they have a mic so i would reccomend them as workout/spoken word/gaming/phone calls. I would not reccomend them for listing to musoc for the joy of it, save up amd get something better
Stopped working after only 28 days. Can't recommend this.

What a great title for a book. I heard the title, saw the cover, and knew I needed to read it. The story is about a "curvy" girl that wants a hero. She wants the man of her dreams, Ron Mitchum, but finds out you can't judge a man by his looks. The next guy isn't right either. Or the next guy. A very fun read.

I had read some reviews saying that this bra ran small and so I ordered TWO band AND cup sizes UP and it was still too small! Definitely along the lines of a sports bra squish effect. The sides do come up high. Glamorise is one the best brands for bras, so I'm very surprised with this one. The front close idea appealed to me, but look carefully, there are 7 (yes, seven) clasps to do up. What a pain. I think if I had ordered 3 sizes up it might be ok. I won't return it as I'm losing weight, so it might fit better down the road. Will update review at that time. If you want a bra that doesn't let you jiggle at all without it being a minimizer and/or without wires, this would be good. UPDATE: After very recent gallbladder surgery that left me with a highly tender incision site, I found I couldn't wear any of my regular bras. I had ordered this one hoping I might be able to tolerate it. Initially, because it was so tight, I couldn't tolerate this one either. As I slowly healed, I kept trying the bra. Due to its elastic nature I was able to adjust this for comfort more than the others. After about two weeks, much to my amazement, I found the bra had lost its initial snugness and was in fact VERY comfortable! 5 weeks after surgery and this is still the only bra I can tolerate. The number of clasps in the front turned out to be a bonus as well, because I could choose to leave the bottom clasps undone, adding to the comfort level. I am still of the opinion that it runs too snug and I'm glad I ordered up. Take the time to break the bra in! All bras have a break-in period (in my opinion), and this one is no different. I'm actually quite happy with it now.

These are excellent filters and do a great job. Water tastes very good after going thru these filters then filtered further in a filtering water pitcher. Which I highly recommend. These filters are great when filtering for general water usage is done. But I recommend further filtering for drinking water.

I've had this on my Kindle for about six months now and reread it multiple times. The formatting holds up perfectly across devices and the bookmarking never glitches even with heavy use. The story itself grabs you from page one and doesn't let go. Dark, twisted, and impossible to put down. Still works flawlessly after dozens of opens. If you like your reads gritty and boundary-pushing, this one's built to last in your collection.
Perfect gift for any collector or Marvel fan. The detail on this guy is seriously impressive for the price.

Got these on sale and honestly they're worth every penny. The seal on each container is super solid - nothing leaks even when I store soups sideways. My only complaint is getting the larger ones open takes some effort, especially with arthritis. Love that the lids stack neatly so I'm not digging through my cabinet anymore. Would've preferred fewer tiny containers and more medium ones, but still a great buy overall.

Watched this on a rainy afternoon and completely got sucked in. The dance world backdrop is fascinating on its own, but what really grabbed me is the tension between MacLaine and Bancroft. You feel every bit of history and regret hanging between them. The confrontation scenes are electric. Also, the ballet sequences are shot beautifully, and you get a real sense of how brutal that profession is on the body and mind. The supporting cast rounds things out nicely without distracting from the central dynamic. I will say the pacing drags slightly in the middle, but the emotional payoff in the final act makes it worth sticking around for. If you enjoy character driven dramas from this era, this holds up remarkably well. Glad I added it to my collection.

Bought this for an upcoming trip to Europe and I've been testing it out for about three weeks now. The low light performance is genuinely impressive, grabbed some shots at dusk that would've been a grainy mess on my phone. Indoor shots without flash come out clean too, which is huge for me since I hate washing everyone out with harsh lighting. My one gripe is the lens cap situation, it dangles awkwardly and I'm already paranoid about losing it. Zoom range is decent but not amazing, so keep expectations realistic there. Overall though, I'd absolutely recommend this to travelers, parents chasing kids around the house, or anyone who wants better-than-smartphone photos without lugging a full DSLR. For the price point, it's a fantastic little shooter.
Thought these would look cheap but they're actually gorgeous. Bigger than expected and the colors are super vibrant.

I wear a 8.5 US (41.5 UK) in Chuck Taylors and Merrills. The La Sportiva fits the same, but is tighter around the middle of the foot. This is as expected as this is my third pair of shoes from La Sportiva. The shoes are very comfortable, and what you'd expect from a hiking shoe. The lacing system is unique and incorporates a lace that goes around the back of the shoe and is tightened when you cinch up the top laces. That makes the show a bit more snug. If you need a wide shoe, I wouldn't recommend these. If you like a snug, secure fit and have an average-width foot, these are great. In my past experience La Sportiva are virtually indestructible. I still have my original two pair but because the sole lugs are worn down use them only for yard work and dock underwater work. The soles, glue, and stitching are all in fine shape even after all that abuse.

I've had this on my Kindle for about three months now and have reread it twice already. The story holds up beautifully on repeat reads, you catch little details you missed the first time around. Ajax is exactly the kind of hero that keeps pulling you back. The emotional moments hit just as hard the second time, and the spicy scenes definitely don't get old. Even after loaning it to my sister and reading it on multiple devices, no formatting glitches. This one has serious staying power. Can't wait for more from this author.
I was completely captured by the story, I learned so much about the history of the Amazon basin and I thoroughly recommend this book.

Wasn't sure what to expect going in but honestly this blew me away. The writing is way sharper than most stuff out now. Ended up binging way past bedtime every single night. Totally worth every penny.
My picky labrador loves these crunchy biscuits. Great size for training treats too.

Cute design but the arch support is basically nonexistent. Broke them in over a week and they still rub my pinky toe raw. Honestly, if you have narrow feet and need something for short outings, these would be fine.
Works great for RV and outdoor use. A bit tough to wash due to their shape.
After reading all the comments I went ahead and purchased it. And sure enough, the surface is slippery, and the ball is not circumferenced completely, but it is working once I got used to it.
Bought this for my daughter's birthday and it's been three months of constant use. Still holding up perfectly with no pieces breaking. Definitely worth every penny.

I grabbed this on a whim expecting one of those generic brooding male lead stories that all blend together after a while. Boy was I wrong. Micah starts off seriously unlikable and I almost DNF'd around chapter three, but something about the way the author peels back his layers kept me hooked. The side characters actually have real opinions about him instead of just propping him up, which made the whole thing feel grounded. By the halfway point I was completely invested. The pacing is solid too, no dragged out misunderstandings just to fill pages. I stayed up way too late finishing it and immediately checked if there's a sequel. If you're tired of the same old formula give this a shot. Way better than I anticipated.

Picked up maybe four local stations, but the signal dropped constantly anytime the wind blew. Honestly, I'd only suggest this to someone in a city apartment super close to the broadcast towers. Rural or suburban folks should look elsewhere.
These are great storage for ammo and almost anything you want to secure and keep water tight. Very satisfied with my purchase.
Really happy with this clock overall. Keeps perfect time and looks great on my wall. Just wish the finish was a bit darker.
Dried meat is safe but I am questioning why they are not sanitized first and if the urine is allowed to stay in/on them, wouldn't the harbor bacteria?

We finally get to know more about Nick and Lila. We know Nick is an a #1 jerk with a chip on his shoulder. We know he can play lead guitar like he was born with one in his hands but we don't know much about his family. In Shattered we learn that even though Nick's twin sister has a drug problem he would do most anything to help her and their dad. We learn about Nick's mom. Cari Quinn makes Nick likable, almost human. Lila is also made human. Even though she is referred to as the Dragon Lady she has problems just like everyone else and two of her biggest are Nick and her husband. One she wants and they other she wants rid of. We get to see where Lila came from and meet her parents in this book. What we do get in this book is a HEA. Sorry folks but it is a cliffhanger. I love this series and will continue to follow Oblivion through to the next book and beyond. Might I suggest you do too?
Thought it'd be flimsy for the price but it's super sturdy. My toddler plays with it every single day outside.

I'm a 34DDD and honestly didn't think a bra this cute could actually handle my chest, but I was wrong. The band stays put all day without riding up, and the straps don't dig into my shoulders like every other bra I own. What really sold me is how the cups fully encapsulate everything without that weird gap or spillage I get from department store brands. The lace detail makes it feel special enough for date night but smooth enough under a work blouse. I've already ordered two more colors. If you're busty and tired of choosing between pretty and supportive, this is your answer. I'd specifically recommend it to anyone over a D cup who has given up on finding something that actually fits right.

Ordered this dock on a Tuesday and it showed up by Thursday which was a nice surprise. Box arrived in great shape, no dents or crushed corners, and everything inside was packed snug with molded foam so nothing was rattling around. Pulled it out and the build quality immediately impressed me, has some actual weight to it and doesn't feel cheap or plasticky at all. The finish looks really sharp on my nightstand too. Plugged my phone in right away and it recognized it instantly, started charging and playing music with zero fuss. Sound is way better than I expected for the size, fills my bedroom easily. Really happy with this purchase so far, feels like a solid step up from the old one I had.

I was expecting a children's film, but it was not. I rented it because I thought it was one of those classic animated films and it is indeed. Not only it's a classic, but it gave me nightmares and it's a good thing though. More animated films should be made like this, but with originality without sugarcoating the violent moments.
The author made it easy for me to feel as if I were part of the celebration of life and nature.

I've had this food processor for about four years now, and it's still going strong. I use it at least twice a week for everything from shredding cheese to making big batches of pesto and the motor hasn't slowed down a bit. The blades are still sharp, which honestly surprised me given how much abuse I've put them through. A few months back I dropped the main bowl on my tile floor and braced for it to shatter, but not a single crack. That said, I will say the feed tube pusher got a little loose after year two, though it still works fine. Overall, this thing has outlasted two cheaper models I owned before it. Genuinely worth the extra money if you cook regularly.
Book arrived in rigid mailer with zero corner dents. Cracked it open immediately and got totally sucked into the Lindbergh saga. Couldn't put it down.

This was my first read for this author. The story itself was fantastic, an excellent whodunit. I really loved some of the characters. There were definitely surprises throughout which I thoroughly enjoyed. What didn't I like about this book? The intimate scenes were almost painful, very hokey. I would love to read more from this author, but would have to skip over the "sizzling" scenes as they just make me cringe.

I managed to devour this book in one day--and I have two small children at home, so that was quite a feat.:-) Diana Wynne Jones does NOT disappoint in this novel! Her clever, thoughtful, and well-laid plot really hooks you in, and the characters are so heart-felt that I truly felt I knew them by the end. The resolution was quite satisfying. Highly recommended for anyone, but most especially for thinking readers who like a challenging puzzle (and where the author gives them all the pieces they need to solve the puzzle right along with the characters.)...

So, I've never read any of Dimon's work, but the blurb had me SUPER interested to see what would happen. I have to say I was NOT let down in the slightest. Although this book was slightly slow to start, and it took me about 5 or 6 chapters to see the charm in Wren, the ending had my eyes bugged out of my head and my heart beating wildly. Emery, I loved her. She was strong, compassionate, and dealt with Wren in ways I don't think I would have been able to (as much as I would love the smokin' hot scenes with him). I loved Garrett and his personality is all me! He's an amazing side character. Wren, of course I loved. His weird, non-humanesque traits made him endearing to me. I most def recommend this book for anyone looking for something a little bit different. You won't be let down. Book provided by Author in exchange for an honest review. Reviewed by The Royal B from B N Books

Oh, my, this is so much fun. My grandson is at my house playing with this toy right now. When you push the center gear, all of the lights start flashing, music plays, and the gears (if they are still on the monkey) start spinning. What I like about the toy is that the gear mechanism spin whether or not the gears are on or off and my grandson can put them on and pull them off without stopping the unit. He loves monkeys, so this toy is perfect for him. While I like learning toys, sometimes you just want a fun toy to play with. This one accomplishes both - it is really fun and there is an opportunity to learn colors and improve fine motor control. The inside gears are in the same colors as the flashing lights. The outside gears are in similar colors. You can play match the colors or you can mix them up on purpose. I also noticed that the little balls that come with his other toys can sit atop the spinning gears and the balls spin, too! Add to that the gears and knobs are just the right size for his one year old hands and he likes to chew them as he is now teething his last two canine teeth (he's already got 14 of his teeth) and the gears seem to hit just the right spot for those last two. The toy is a lot more fun that I expected and I would not hesitate to give it as a gift or to buy for the little one in your life.

I'm using my dimmer with LED bulbs. After 6 months of use they still work great and I haven't had any problems with them. It would be nice if you knew where the dial was going to end up when you are done screwing it in. For this price you can't go wrong and this can save you money with incandescent light bulbs too. Your bulbs will last longer if they are dimmed even by 25 percent.

This harness fits my dog perfectly and she seems very comfortable in it! I am extremely happy with it..and for the price, you can't go wrong! I will agree with other reviews that the straps are a little difficult to adjust, but once you adjust it for your dog's size, you shouldn't need to do it again.
this is a great figure i would get this in a heart beat if i didn't already have him
Honestly didn't expect much from a Class 2 card at this price, but it's been totally solid in my old MP3 player. Loads tracks without any hiccups. Way better than I anticipated.

I bike in about 20 degree cold every morning during the winter and I have cold air induced asthma so a good balaclava is important to me. This one is excellent, it's warm, its breathable without letting too much cold in and the fit is snug without being too tight. The drawbacks are its a little short length on the neck so you need a high collar to tuck it into and the portion that covers your nose squishes it badly. A little longer on the neck and just a bit more fabric across the nose and this would get five stars. Overall, Underarmor continues to satisfy my extreme endurance needs with superior product technology.

For the price I honestly expected a lot more. The sound is fine, nothing mind-blowing but decent enough for daily use. My issue is the build quality. The hinges feel incredibly flimsy from day one, and sure enough after about five months of normal office use one side snapped clean through. I baby my electronics too, always stored in the case when not in use. My old pair from a different brand lasted four years under the same conditions for half the money. Comfort is okay for short sessions but the ear cushions get warm and sweaty after an hour or so. Battery life was solid, I'll give them that, but what good is battery life when the thing physically falls apart? Disappointed given the hype around these.

Got this for my German Shepherd who normally destroys plush toys within hours. We've had it for about six weeks now and it's still mostly intact, which is honestly a miracle. She carries it around everywhere and even uses it as a pillow at night. A handful of the squeakers have gone quiet from her constant gnawing, but the majority still work and the outer fabric hasn't torn yet. For a heavy chewer this is absolutely worth the money. Will definitely buy another when this one eventually wears out.

This is the final book in the Trilogy of "Oryx and Crake" and "Year of the Flood". I believe if you had not read the first 2 novels in the series you would not really enjoy this final book - you would miss so much. Yes, Ms. Atwood does refer back to the other 2 books to explain, but there is just so much to connect to - as much of a feeling of the other 2 books, as just details This 3rd novel is about the survivors of the waterless flood gathering together for strength against their common enemy,the Painballers. Toby and Zeb have the largest parts in this book. They take the most chances to save the remaining survivors and the Crakers (recombined DNA humanoids). Toby's nightly stories to the Crakers are full of both sadness and humor - because the Crakers are so peace-loving that they almost seem like small children. This is not as action-packed as the other 2 novels - it is a winding down and a closing. I really enjoyed it though - especially Toby's comments and explanations to the Crakers:)
Bought this dress for a Christmas party. It is sooooo cute and flattering.
Looks good. A little cheaply constructed, cap broke when I tried to unscrew it to put the fabric on.
They fit perfect, they look expensive, they are the most confortable shoes that i had ever. I love the design
Way thicker and tougher than I expected. Figured it'd be decent but this stuff is heavy-duty. Wired up a 50ft cord and it handles my table saw no problem.

Got this on a Kindle deal and honestly it was worth way more than what I paid. The Heather storyline completely surprised me - I went from hating her to actually rooting for the woman. The emotional punches kept coming and I stayed up way too late finishing it. Knocking off one star because the middle dragged a bit and I had to push through. Still, for under three bucks this was a solid grab. The Mitchell brothers series keeps getting better.

Honestly wasn't expecting much for the price but these have held up way better than the pricier bowls I've bought at pet stores. The stainless steel is solid, no dents after my clumsy dog knocked it off the counter twice, and the rubber bottom ring actually stays put instead of sliding everywhere. Cleanup is easy, just toss them in the dishwasher and they come out spotless. No rust spots either, which was a problem with a different brand I tried last year. I got the medium size for my cat and it's perfect, deep enough that she doesn't fling food out but shallow enough for her to reach the bottom comfortably. For what you're paying, you really can't go wrong. Already ordered a second set for the upstairs water station.
Got these for my niece and she wears them every day. Super soft, durable, and you can't beat the price. Will grab another pair soon.

Watched it with my kids last weekend and the surround sound mix is incredible. The spaceship landing scene literally shook my living room. Bonus features were a letdown though, wish there were more behind-the-scenes stuff.
Perfect for the "library!" But started to rust where it hangs from the toilet tank.
Bought these for everyday wear and they're solid. Took a couple days to break in but comfortable now.
I am an elderly handicapped woman and I love this. Very easy for me to use and I have used it a few times already. Just put it on the charger - came pre charged and worked immediately.
Exactly what I needed for organizing cables and small parts. Super handy size, feels sturdy, and the price was unbeatable. Definitely recommend.
Everything included; worked as advertised. MUCH better than using flashdrives or DVDs.

I wrote a review b4 but Amazon didn't accept it(I was horribly angry). So it wasn't published. I bought this costume for my 4yro daughter who was In love with it. Me I hated it. It's very shiny like foil. It tore in one day and kept tearing. It was a little big but that's how I wanted so it'll last. I threw it in the trash about 4 months after purchasing it. It really isn't sturdy or tasteful. Hope you like my review now Amazon. Wish I took a pic of it before I threw it away.

Bought this complete series set over two years ago and the discs still play flawlessly despite being passed around my whole family. Great show with solid episodes. Packaging held up nicely too. Definitely worth picking up.

Picked this up for working under my truck at night and the beam spread is honestly impressive. Lights up the whole undercarriage without needing to reposition it constantly. Build quality feels solid and the magnetic base sticks tight to metal surfaces. My only gripe is the advertised lumen rating seems generous compared to other lights I own. It's bright enough for close work but don't expect it to reach far down a driveway. Still, gets the job done for mechanics.

The Problem: Samsung Galaxy Tab comes with ridiculously short charging cable. The Solution: Juiced Systems Extra Long Charging Cable. I've received this dual charging cable as well as the Juiced Systems standard extra long Galaxy Tab cable and they are both great. With this dual Galaxy Tab & Micro USB cable, I can charge both my Tab Plus 7.0 and Galaxy Nexus phone at the same time with just one cable. This will be my go-to travel cable. Juiced Systems also really supports their products and customers. They were extremely responsive to email questions and when I had a small issue with one of the initial cables I received, and they sent me a replacement cable almost instantly. Can't say enough good things about their customer service. So if you have a Galaxy Tablet, this is the solution you should look to. I will warn you that other extended cables for the Tab may not charge with enough current to maintain a charge while using your Tab. The Juiced Systems cables provide me with the same charging as I get with the original short Samsung cable.
Not as steamy as I'd hoped based on the description. The history stuff was interesting though, and the writing itself is decent. Curious where the sequel goes.
Cool concept but direction stays inaccurate and thermometer runs hot. Meh overall.

Arrived two days early in a nice zippered bag instead of crammed in a cheap envelope. Opened it up and the material feels way more substantial than I expected. The color matches the photos perfectly and the stitching looks solid right out of the package. Really impressed so far.

Nice product. Solid build and good parts and teflon tape included. I was quite impressed with this item. Sadly, I did not get to install it at all -- as I was checking all the parts -- It became clear that the hot and cold hoses (which are also good quality) are quite short -- the ones I got are 22" (almost 23" if you count the attached nuts). Most sinks will be at the limit of these hoses or require longer hoses/extenders. My standard sink with the taps directly below the faucet required at least +6" more to get from the faucet to the tap. Returned. I will def. look at more Vapsint products for the replacement.
Been using this for six months now and it's held up great. No wobbling or fading at all.

I download a lot of books but rarely read them all the way through. This was different -- I enjoyed learning more about the gaming world, there was romance and a good plot, and enough sex for those who want it. It was very much Fifty Shades of Grey in the gaming world, and parts were a little like Pretty Woman, but both with a more independent and intelligent heroine. The only distractions were that the entire book needs an editor to proofread it, and maybe a little too much detail about what the main characters were wearing. Oh, and the techie terms and name pronunciations should have been up front or referenced at the beginning. Looking forward to reading more from this author!
Classic Nora Roberts, exactly what I wanted. The romance hits all the usual beats without reinventing anything. Perfect lazy weekend read.
Just wanted I wanted, expected, and ordered. Good job, thank you.
Been wearing these almost daily for six months now and they still look practically new. So comfy I forgot I had them on.

When a sump pump goes bellyup it usually happens when you need it most. Which means you can't wait for shipping or shop price, you head to the hardware store and pay top buck. After numerous Wayne pump float switches died (usually just after the warranty expires)I saw this one with the Switch Genius technology. At 3/4 HP it was more pump than I needed and it was the most expensive sump pump I ever bought. But I figured if the switch was more reliable than float switches the piece of mind would be worth the money. I noticed the switch cycles the pump on early and shuts off only after sucking air for 10 - 15 seconds. After some severe storms a few weeks later I came home from work and could smell something hot. The pump wasn't turning off and was hotter than blazes! After following the manual and cleaning off the sensor it still wouldn't shut off. After unplugging the pump for half an hour or so it appeared to work normally again. Every time there's a storm I have trouble with the water sensor not shutting off the pump. Wayne says to send it back for a replacement on my dime. It weighs a ton and is going to be expensive to ship. Plus, what do I do for a pump while there's two in transit? I had a Zoeller pump for over ten years with no problems until the switch died. I had to go with Waynes because that's what the hardware store carried and like I said, when you need a replacement you usually need it in a hurry. I've gone through 5 Wayne pumps in 6 years, this will be the last.
Can't beat the price for what these do. I keep one in my hiking pack and another in the glovebox. Surprisingly clear glass for the cost. Started a fire on our last trip in seconds. Worth every penny.

What really hooked me was the world-building. The author created such a detailed supernatural hierarchy that felt believable without info-dumping. Lash and Naomi's dynamic kept me turning pages way past bedtime. The emotional stakes ramp up perfectly across all three books. If you're a fan of the angelically irreverent Mark Twain, there's a *very* high probability you will enjoy this. It's a delightful interpretation of what Twain's lecture series performances would have been like. I particularly enjoy this performance because of the artistry of Mr. Holbrook's interpretation and delivery of Twain: Twain was supposedly the master of the comic pause for effect, and Holbrook seems a fine practitioner of that art. Much of the material was familiar to me from reading Twain. Yet the performance certainly adds another dimension to one's enjoyment of Mark Twain's high art of civilized comedy and truthful commentary on the human condition. It is a comedy that is merciful to what is sincere and merciless to what is false - always seasoned with humility. It is a comedy, that with exceptions such as Garrison Keillor, modern America has forgotten. Twain's honesty, perspicacity, humility, and irreverence were what made him the luminary he was: The majority of modern comics only score one out of four on that list. If watching this performance motivates you to read one of Twain's books, I highly commend Roughing It. My only caveat about this program is you may subsequently feel betrayed and defrauded by all the "comedians" and "humorists" you have listened to before, and subsequently find it odious to return to their company. Btw, this can be watched for free online.

That said, the footbed itself is really comfortable and the material holds up well outdoors without trapping odors. I'd recommend these to people with narrow or low-volume feet who want a durable slip-on. If your feet run wide or you have a high instep, probably look elsewhere. Not bad for the price, just wish the band had a little more give.

I loved this item. The design is nice. The colors work together well. Its most definitely good quality and made to last a long time. My puppy didn't have any issues with putting it on or wearing it. This book along with the series is an excellent read. I hesitated with the first book, because I thought time travel with civil war, but I am so glad that I went on and read the first book along with the series of books. I would recomment to anyone that loves civil war romance.

I have 4 cats, so I can't afford to splurge on their food. And sometimes they don't all like one product, and that doesn't work for me. This kibble is liked by all 4 cats and seems more healthful than some of the less expensive brands. Good luck pleasing your cats!
Couldn't put it down. The courtroom scenes were incredibly realistic and had me hooked from the very first page.
This was one of the best mc reads and I read at least 6 novels a week was always on edge not knowing what's around the corner... Definite recommend reads can't wait for another

This keyboard is pretty great. It takes a while to get used to... I have an iMac at home and a IBM Thinkpad at work. I prefer Thinkpad keys, but are getting used to the new Apple keyboard without any problem. No difference really with the extended wired keyboard that comes with the new imac in terms of feel. The size makes it great to use instead of the wired keyboard. Of course, with the wired keyboard, you also would have 2 extra USB ports... The only problem I have is when you use VMWare to run Vista, I tend to lose connections with both the wireless keyboard and mouse (both bluetooth). This problem doesn't go away when you quite VMWare. I have to plug in the wired keyboard and mouse to continue. A bit of annoyance, but won't be a problem if you don't use VMWare to run Windows. Hope this helps.
I bought this for my mother and she absolutely loves the show, item came as described with 2 day shipping, YAY prime.

Gloves showed up in a thin plastic mailer with no packaging inside, just rattling around loose. One of them had a crease folded right into the palm that still hasn't fully flattened out. Material feels flimsy for something marketed as cold weather gear, and the stitching on the left thumb was already coming undone straight out of the bag. Sizing runs small too, which wouldn't be a huge deal if the quality matched the price. Haven't tested them on the bike yet but honestly not optimistic based on what I'm seeing. Expected better for the money. Two stars because they at least arrived.

I had purchased shark tooth mats locally for my home gym and needed more. I'm glad I found these on Amazon. These were better than my original mats. These are gym quality mats. They are HEAVY because they are heavy duty and protect any flooring. They are also comfortable on my feet when I am working out. I highly recommend these over cheaper, lighter weight, and thinner mats some stores sell.

Ordered this used copy and was honestly surprised it showed up in just two days. The seller wrapped it in bubble wrap and a sturdy mailer so the corners weren't dinged at all, which is rare for paperback shipping these days. Cracked it open right at the mailbox and ended up sitting in my car reading the first chapter. Salzman's writing just pulls you in immediately. The way he handles the main character's past as a former cello prodigy alongside the jury duty storyline is seamless and genuinely moving. I'm only about halfway through but already know this one's going on my keep shelf. If you're into literary fiction with real emotional depth, grab a copy. Solid read, great condition, fast delivery.

We used these to make vampire donuts, using plain glazed donuts from the grocery store, and used skittles as the eyes. These did work, but the hinge portion on some was too thick and they popped open a bit, on a few of them. Poor QA/QC there, I think! We solved that by closing/folding them closed first and pressing hard with a metal serving spoon and creasing and reinforcing that folded hinge area, and then placing them in the donuts. It worked great! We scattered them on tables, in among bags of pretzels and wrapped candy, and also placed these in big glass jars with spooky printed labels we stuck on the fronts. They're small, so only the kids could really wear them comfortably, but they worked great for our purposes.
Love it. Been looking for a fitting camo hat and this is perfect. Fit was about there; maybe a hair small but very very close.
Awesome deal for the price. I light my grill with these all the time. It only takes me a few shavings to get the rest of the fire bundled going. For what I use it for it will last me a long time

I've been using this grinder daily for about three weeks now and I'm seriously impressed. My favorite part is the adjustable grind size, I can go from a coarse French press grind to something fine enough for my espresso machine, and it actually hits the right consistency each time. My old grinder was a guessing game, but this one is consistent every single morning. Cleanup is also a breeze. The removable chamber means I'm not awkwardly wiping out the interior or getting coffee dust everywhere. It's loud, sure, but what grinder isn't? For the price, you're getting something that punches well above its weight. I've already recommended it to two coworkers who keep asking about my coffee setup. Definitely worth every penny.
Solid, fun entertainment! If you liked clash of the titans you should like this.
Arrived quickly in perfect condition. My kid went nuts when he unboxed this truck. Super sturdy too.

This bar is great. I like the dip bars and the high wide grip pull up. This would be a 5 star product if it had some sort of latch or strap that secures the hanging dip bar. Otherwise, it will move around a bit.
These glasses are a great value. The quality is as expected for the price. They should perform adequately.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but these are surprisingly solid. My 2-year-old has been absolutely smashing them around in the sandbox for weeks and they're holding up great. No cracks or breaks yet.

I cannot thank my boss enough for recommending Oofos sandals to me...my feet are in heaven! My feet are wide, and flat. I call it "Fred Flintstone Syndrome". Trying to find shoes that a) fit correctly; and b) don't cause me to limp after a few hours is nearly impossible. I have literally spent hundreds upon hundreds of dollars in the past five years trying to find footwear that I can actually wear on a day to day basis. I have tried orthopedic inserts, Dr. Scholls inserts...you name it - I've probably tried it at least once. Sandals were by far the most difficult to find, as most do not offer any support at all. This results in my feet taking a pounding and me being in excruciating pain within an hour or so. Unfortunately, it is hot and humid where I live from May to late September - my feet sweat easy - so I really do not want to wear closed shoes and have to deal with *that* particular issue. These Oofos...I'm in love. I can wear these all day, and my feet are so happy. The comfort, the arch support - phenomenal. I love the black/silver color combination - it looks very classy and goes with pretty much anything I wear. Seriously, these are more comfortable than my $200 running shoes. I can't even be barefoot anymore - when I am at home, puttering around and doing chores, I have these babies on. I put them in my work tote and slip out of my dress shoes and wear these at my desk. I simply cannot get enough of them. I will be purchasing more of these Oolala thong flip flops, in different colors. I no longer dread family outings (say, at an amusement park) because I finally have comfortable footwear to walk around in all day, without having to be the wet blanket that continually needs to sit down and "rest her feet." I wish I could give these sandals more than 5 stars. They're perfect. I am a very, very satisfied customer!

It's a well-made toy but my 7 month old doesn't really care for it. If I push the button she'll watch the balls move but it doesn't really hold her interest. Occasionally she'll just kind of pick it up and shake it. She's hit into it more times than she's actually played with it so it's probably done more harm than good in the 2 months I've owned it!
The band is comfortable and the sizing runs true, but two rhinestones were missing right out of the package. Disappointening for the price.

Arrived two days early in a sturdy box with no damage to the case. Popped in the first disc right away and the picture quality is crisp. I'm already hooked after three episodes. The storylines pull you in immediately. Super happy with this purchase overall.

when I started buying this litter a few years back I loved it and the price was about $14.99 but the price has doubled since then I have 7 cats and I just can't afford it anymore, it's a shame too because I liked it. this light has been installed for a few days now, so far so good. superrrr bright. like ridiculously bright. light reaches out a good 40-50' EASY. motion sensor picks me up from about 20 ft away, and im a tiny guy, creeping slowly like a stalker. neighbors are probably like wtf? only reason i didn't give it 5 stars was bc the housing for the light itself is a little tricky/ "poorly" dedigned. i ended up having to take it all apart to get the main mount screwed down, the put reattach the light to the holding arm. basically, with this unit once it is installed per instruction you can either have a semi loose horizontal swinging motion, or a semi loose vertical motion. bc i took mine apart and reassembled, its tighter than a pair of kardashian pants. if you know anything about hardware/ afroengineering, this is a great product for you

Despite their hit-and-miss filmography, the Coen Brothers never could be accused of making a bad movie. Then along came "Hail, Caesar!" a star-studded "satire" of 1950s Hollywood filled with misfired in-jokes and unrelenting tedium. In other words, "The Big Lebowski" without the laughs. Stunning period detail fails to camouflage a shockingly weak Coen script. Josh Brolin's inspired performance as studio fixer Eddie Mannix deserves a much better film.

Needed this adapter to mount my post-mount caliper onto an IS fork with a 180mm rotor. Honestly didn't expect much for the price but Shimano knocked it out of the park. The machining is super clean and everything lined up perfectly on the first try with zero rubbing or alignment issues. Hardware was included which saved me a trip to the bike shop. For what these cost compared to some fancy aftermarket brands you really can't go wrong. Holds solid after weeks of aggressive trail riding with no flex whatsoever. Great bang for your buck.

Honestly exceeded what I was anticipating. The cushions feel way more supportive than the flat pancake pads I've seen on similar futons. Assembly wasn't bad at all, maybe 45 minutes solo. It's heavier than it looks, which actually reassures me about durability. Fits perfectly in my small office/guest room. My brother slept on it last weekend and said it was genuinely comfortable. No regrets here.

It is nice bowl and have had a fast shipping!

For the price these are decent enough. I got them on sale and needed something for casual Friday at work. The material is obviously not premium leather but it passes if you're not looking too close. They run a touch big so I'd size down half. My main complaint is the sole feels pretty thin and I can tell they won't last more than a season of regular wear. That said, they look sharp with khakis and the cushioning inside is actually pretty comfortable for a few hours. Not mad I bought them, just wouldn't pay full retail.
Re-read this three times since buying it last year. Still holds up beautifully. Small-town secrets done right.

Ordered this on a whim and it arrived next day in a sturdy mailer with no bent corners, which I always appreciate. The cover art is even better in person and the spine didn't crack when I opened it flat. Started reading during lunch and honestly didn't want to go back to work. The writing pulls you in immediately and the main couple had me invested by chapter two. What surprised me most was how natural the dialogue feels, nothing forced or cheesy. The pacing hits that sweet spot where you keep telling yourself one more chapter. Even the secondary characters left me wanting more. Already preordered the sequel. Solid shipping, beautiful physical copy, and a story that actually delivers.

Watched insidious chapter 2 the other night and I enjoyed it. If you liked the first one you will probably enjoy the follow up. The movie picks up pretty much after the events of the first film. And the Lambert family now have their son back and are trying to get back to normal family life. But as the movie goes on they can tell that something is off about Mr. Lambert played by Patrick Wilson. He just is not the same after saving his son from the other side following the events of the first film. Loved how they tied everything together in the sequel and I would definitely watch this again. Check it out.

I picked this up after burning through Julie Garwood's historical romances, and honestly the shift to contemporary romantic suspense threw me off at first. The chemistry between Nick and Laurant is decent, and some of the banter genuinely made me laugh. But the thriller plot feels pretty generic, a stalker villain with motivations that don't totally hold up if you think about them for more than two minutes. I also wanted more from the supporting cast, especially Father Tommy. He had potential but ended up feeling like a plot device. That said, if you're someone who likes lighter romantic suspense with a side of religion-themed drama and doesn't need the mystery to be airtight, you'll probably enjoy this more than I did.

Bought this for my son doing a 5-day hike in the Sierras. Worked fine. Big enough and didn't rip or break. My son, at 6'1", found it comfortable. I'm prejudiced toward exterior frames, but thought it was a decent pack for occasional/casual backpacking. Believe we'll be using for years to come.

Watched this with my teenagers and we were all blown away. The animation is gorgeous, but man, this thing goes to some surprisingly dark places. It doesn't hold back or talk down to the audience. I'd highly recommend it to parents of older kids who can handle intense themes, skip it for the little ones. If you appreciate films that treat viewers with respect, grab this immediately.

I have not yet shot with this scope, NOT YET MOUNTED. 1) It took over 4 weeks to receive it from time of ordering. 2) The whole scope was covered with dust. 3) The objective lens had smear marks on it but cleaned with a microfiber cloth alright. 4) When I took the lens caps off after the 4 day return policy had expired, much to my surprise I discovered that the objective lens tube AT THE END was FLAT for about 2 inches instead of round. The tube is NOT flat anywhere at the objective lens itself, but at the end of the scope. That is more than a drop - that is someone sending me a scope from China that was mis-manufactured and hoping I'd never take the lens cover off I guess. Since I'm stuck with the flawed product, I will still try shooting long range with it and report more later.
Perfect for my drill press. The firm grip means they stay put during operation but release smoothly when intentional.

Jack feels like a completely different character and the pacing drags so badly I kept checking how much time was left. Previous seasons had me glued to the screen but I caught myself scrolling through my phone during multiple episodes. The writing is sloppy, the new characters are forgettable, and the storylines feel like recycled material. Even the action sequences which used to be top notch feel generic and rushed. By the halfway point I honestly did not care anymore. If this is the direction the show is heading then I am done with it. Save your money and just rewatch the earlier seasons instead.

I really like this alarm clock so far. It works very well with the iPhone and I've only had a few small issues with it. Occasionally when you put the iPhone in the cradle it will only start charging the phone, but it won't play the audio. I've only had this happen maybe twice since I bought it 2 months ago. I think it's something to do with if you're playing a song already when you plug the phone into the dock. It looks great, and I really like how the dock slides back into the clock for when you're not using it. The dimmer is nice, but I wish it would maybe go one shade darker. The audio quality is superb considering the size. Overall, I'm very happy with the money I spent on this unit compared to the other ones available on Amazon.

Bought this for my iPad and the magnetic wake/sleep function works perfectly every time. Fits snug and the auto cutout for the speaker is spot on. Dropped it twice already and no damage to the tablet or the case. Worth every penny.

For the price I am not sure it can be beat. I have used it during several rounds and it is within a few yards of much higher priced range finders and GPS watches that my friends use. Pin lock will at times lock right on with the same reading each time. Other times, it will take a bit and give me a different reading each time but never more than 3-7 yards of variance. Different readings each time is a pain but I am not that accurate with my irons anyway so it is not a deal breaker for me. As long as this unit lasts I consider this a huge win.

Got the download instantly which was great since I was eager to dive in. The cover looked clean and professional, so my first impression was solid. Honestly didn't expect much from another "make money" book, but the author actually breaks things down into practical steps instead of vague advice. Already started testing two of the side hustle ideas and seeing some traction. Wish there was a little more detail on the freelance chapter, but overall really glad I grabbed this.

Picked this up on a whim to replace my aging center channel and honestly I'm blown away. The dialogue clarity is night and day compared to what I had before. Voices that used to get lost in action scenes now cut through clean and crisp. Build quality feels solid for what I paid, has some real weight to it. For anyone on the fence, just pull the trigger. You'd have to spend double to notice any real difference.

Since these were for my daughter, I know she would lose a cup at some point without it. She is using them because they are teaching speed stacking in school. She loved that she could take her own set of cups in for the competition.
Awesome hat. The adjustable strap in the back holds tight and doesn't slip like other camo caps I've tried. Breathable material keeps my head cool during long hunts.

I've been following this series from the beginning and this finale really delivers. The author doesn't hold back with the heavy stuff, Cassie goes through so much and watching her navigate everything she's been through felt authentic and not rushed. Cody's journey broke my heart at times, especially when they're forced apart. What I loved most is how their relationship isn't portrayed as some perfect fairy tale fix. They struggle, they mess up, but the connection between them is what keeps them fighting. I stayed up way too late finishing this because I couldn't put it down. If you've invested in the earlier books, this conclusion is absolutely worth it. Fair warning: have tissues ready. Really powerful ending to a series I'll definitely be rereading.
Was disappointed in the twist shifters and response from the stock brake levers on my daughters bike so I bought these as a replacement and they are very nice. No complaints.
beware...very very small!! very small!! easily could be swallowed by a puppy!! let alone by a dog!!
Really happy with these. Broke them in after a day and now they're my go-to for work. Solid quality for the price.

Got this as a quick lunch break read and ended up finishing it before I even went back to work. For under a buck, you really can't complain. The romance between Lenore and the wolf shifter guy had decent tension and I liked that she wasn't written as some fragile little thing. She felt like an actual person I'd know. The pacing moves fast without skipping over the important emotional stuff. Sure, it's a short story so there's only so much world-building you get, but what's there works well enough. I've paid way more for full-length novels in this genre that weren't half as entertaining. Already grabbed the next one in the series. If you're into shifter romance and want something fun that won't eat your whole afternoon, this is a solid pick.

Total waste of money. For a "premium" pump I expected way better. The Switch Genius feature is the whole reason I spent extra, and it still gets stuck constantly. My old cheap pump ran for 15 years with zero issues. This thing barely lasted four months before the motor started sounding like it's grinding rocks. Called customer support and they told me to mail it back at my own expense for warranty evaluation. Are you kidding me? I can't exactly go without a sump pump for three weeks while they look at it. Had to run to the store and buy a backup just to keep my basement from flooding. For this price point the build quality is honestly insulting. Don't fall for the marketing like I did.

I can only give this item two stars. That is because I like the print and the material, and the overall design of the dress. I am a U.S. size 8/9. I have recently lost weight, so Ihave trouble sizing online items sometimes. I first ordered a U.K. size 14 in this dress, then a U.K. size 12. I don't know if they do things much different in the UK but it seems I must be a non-existent size which is in between the two previously mentioned sizes. The size 12 is extremely tight. It fits well in the hip and midsection area but is ridiculously tight in the chest area....to the degree that it smashed my breasts into pretty much two flat pancakes that looked really unusual from a side profile. Boobs are supposed to be round. I needed help getting in and out of the dress, since there is no zipper, I struggled pulling it over my head. The size 14 was way too large...the dress fit baggy and awkward everywhere. There was more than enough room in the chest area (surprisingly) but that meant that the bottom half of the dress was huge around my hips. It wasn't flattering at all because the dress didn't have any need to cling or stretch to anything, it just hangs there. I don't care to return these dresses because the shipping rate will probably cost more than the dress itself, so i'll probably sell them. Long story short, this is a beautifully designed dress but PLEASE be careful if you are a busty woman because it may not flatter you but FLATTEN you. Also, the fit of this dress may make you consider if this is a dress for a night out, or if it's work-appropriate. This would work well for a woman with a small chest but ample hips. For reference, I am 5'3, 140lbs, 36D-29-39. Hope this helps someone.

Wore it to a wedding back in April and got tons of compliments. Washed it on delicate per the instructions and hung it to dry. By the second wash the seams along the bodice started fraying badly. It's a shame because it really is a beautiful design. Two stars because it looked great initially, but I can't recommend something that falls apart this fast.

I honestly don't know what the hype is about. The characters are awful to each other from page one and nobody gets any kind of redemption arc. It's just misery piled on misery with zero payoff at the end. If you're already feeling down, stay far away from this one. I'd only recommend it to readers who enjoy bleak literary fiction with no uplifting moments whatsoever. Found it draining and ultimately pointless.

Honestly struggled to get through this one. The story drags endlessly and the characters feel flat compared to the original series. I kept waiting for it to pick up but it never really did. After about 200 pages I just gave up. If you're a fan of the earlier books, this will likely disappoint. Not worth the time or money unfortunately.

This book was quite interesting to me. I agree that many people, even Christians can't handle laments. Most of us are silenced and reduced to "faking fine. " No one really wants to know anything about the negative. But everyone seems to be a counselor and offers advice that's unwanted and unneeded. I couldn't relate to the author's neverending supply of supportive friends who helped her all along the way with her issues. I found myself wanting to feel more sorry for her lack of relationship with her family, but I had some questions. She left her brother out of her story almost altogether. How did he react to events? I couldn't relate to the somewhat shallow craving for shopping and closets full of shoes. I don't lament things. I'm not into prosperity gospel. And who gets to go on a long retreat to Alaska to heal? Almost none of us. I think I was hoping for more of a workbook than a personal account. The book touches on a lot of good points about biblical laments in Psalms, Job, Lamentations. Some of the stories became repetitive and I think it could have been condensed a bit. The book is a good commentary of realizing that many of us are not "just fine.

I wasn't bothered by "Extremely Dangerous'" obvious borrowing of a central premise from "The Fugitive." It was the lack of suspense and surprises that got to me. I expected a thrill ride of a movie, but it never materialized over the long 3-hour 20-minute DVD. Obviously, the script is the greatest weakness here. In terms of suspense or mystery, it is a total flop. None of the clues amount to much, you can see the supposed plot twists a mile away, and the villains are easy to spot. The worst part was how the scriptwriter got the protagonist out of scrapes -- much like an old-time serial, there is even a scene where he dives into the water and is surrounded, seemingly without escape. Then, fade out. Fade in to Sean Bean back at his apartment. How he managed to escape is never shown or explained! What I assume was the lack of much of a budget seems evident by other odd choices. In one scene, a skyscraper is said to be burning to the ground, but instead of seeing any part of it, we're told about it (with the sound effect of sirens in the background). A low budget is not always a liability, if it spurs creativity, which was not the case here. What might have made this bearable -- an interesting main performance -- is not forthcoming from Bean. He exhibits no range or subtlety. That leaves the interesting bits to supporting actors -- in particular, Nitin Ganatra as a Pakistani cab service operator. His scenes crackle, but little else in the movie does.

The heroine, Catherine, learns that not everything in reality has a Gothic fiction story. That fiction is just that. Catherine Morland (17) goes to Bath with friends. She then meets Henry Tilney, whom invites her to his family's home - Northanger Abbey. Catherine expected a Gothic Abbey to match with the novels she reads (mainly Ann Radcliffe the creator of Gothic Romance). The comedy is that the Abbey, Henry and the Tilney's are just the opposite. They are wealthy "English Christians." There are other subtext to parody of social marriages and manners. Jane Austen's books all have this comedic point if view. I would recommend this novel.

The newest addition to the town comes in the form of Alison (Ally as affectionately referred to by Ryder). Alison comes to Desire on the heels of a bad breakup from an abusive boyfriend. Similar to all the other stories in the series, Dillon and Ryder come swooping into her life completing ensconcing themselves in it while overwhelming her with their (neanderthalithic) overbearing ways and masculinity. The story prattled along at a lumbering pace, IMHO, as Alison whined about things being "none of your (Dillion and Ryder's) business" (said 14 times) and spanking threats from the men (mentioned 33 times...yes...I counted). The story was highly repetitive...not only of itself but of the other stories in the series. Really the characters in these stories are interchangeable because the story lines are so consistent with one other. This series now has 8 books in it...and honestly, as a reader, I'm getting to the point where I don't care because there is nothing unique about them anymore. Desire for Three: Winning Back Jesse is actually about the characters in Desire for Three. *Scratches my head*....so now we're going back and revisiting characters? Pass! Don't get me wrong, I enjoy Leah Brooke's work, I just want to see some originality come into play in her stories. As they are now...they are just meh because of near exactness of the stories and characters -- resistant females...dominant men...and they all live happily ever after. I'd like to see her throw some different characters in a the mix. Send someone of a different nationality to Desire to find love. Send a couple looking to add to their triad.......give me something different to work with. Raw Desire wasn't unenjoyable...I just though it could have been much better and different. Majority Rules Card Game by Flat River Group is an interesting party game on an original premise. The rule is pretty simple. Players pick five candidates, real or fictional, at the start of the game. The chairperson then picks a question card from the pile and reads it out. Players vote for the candidate to whom they think the question is most applicable. The majority wins. All players start with 10 points each and would bet 1-3 points based on how confident that they would win the round. Most of the questions are edgy and ludicrous. How fun the game would be largely depends on the initial selection of the five candidates and how the players would go all out on a debate and defend their votes. If you have a good mix of candidates and a group of imaginative and outspoken players, the game is gonna be fun and awesome. If not, you will very soon find the group ready to move on. Although this may be a fun and ludicrous party game, some of the questions presented tend to be adult only (sex related). As such, I'm seriously doubt that the age 14 and up rating from the manufacturer is appropriate. I would personally remove those questions before passing it to my teenager when he has his friends over. The game comes with everything you'll need such as a dry erase board and pen for writing the five candidates down, 1-2 point chips for betting and spinners for selecting your own vote.

After 5 novels hasn't Mr. Moody learned that you just, can't, put, a comma, wherever you want to? And at times, well, a comma is needed. This could be credited to extreme sloppiness and mistakes that editors should notice right away. Like the fact that California is 9, not 8 hours behind Amsterdam. Consecutive chapter headings of Wednesday the 10th and Thursday the 12th (with a mention of Friday the 13th) make me wonder what happened to the 11th day of that month. Mr Baker is referred to as "Mrs" Baker. (What the hell do editors do these days?) And there are probably others that my quick reading or fading memory have missed. If you have a craving for some Chet Baker (who doesn't/shouldn't?) I would suggest de Valk's bio, or pre-order Gavin's. If you have mystery fix, just buy Elmore Leonard. I am not familiar with the other works of Mr Moody, I like the idea of jazz mysteries but heavily shy away from silly clichs and most of all bad writing. If anything I hope this will turn a few people on to the lovely music of Chet Baker.

This book's biggest accomplishment is reminding one what a great work of art Nabakov's masterpiece is. My main problem with Tampa was that the main character did come across as a believable human being. Whereas Humbert Humbert for all his deviant predilections was often a relateable character, Celeste, the sexual-predator narrator and overwhelmingly dominant figure of Tampa, struck me as a one note, sex-addled sociopath; all the other characters in the book are too peripheral to engage much of the reader's attention. Tampa is filled with detailed and uninteresting sex scenes. The main interest is wondering how Celete's downfall will be brought about. I hoped Celeste's ensuing public disgrace and trial to turn to a Bonfire of the Vanities type spectacle but that section of the book apparently occupied little of the author's attention because it sped by perfunctorily. I was drawn to Tampa initially by enthusiastic reviews in credible sources such as Slate. I wonder if much of this enthusiasm was the result of the phenomenon of male critics being automatically wowed and over impressed when female artists frankly address female sexuality (cf. Liz Phair). Lisa Zeidner's review in the Washington Post (available online as of this writing) seemed a more accurate assessment of Tampa. One may wonder why I gave Tampa even three stars. First of all, I'm a generous grader when it comes to books. Second of all, it did contains several humorous passages and passages of well wrought writing. Third of all, despite its flaws, I'll remember it. Lastly the author deserves some credit for daring the comparison to a canonical masterwork and inspiring one to reread its literary inspiration.
